title: Savings Bridge: Strategy and Ops Roadmap for Batching, Caching, and Quantization
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Consolidated initiative to reduce per-token cost across hosted and dedicated deployments via coordinated batching, KV/prefix caching, and model quantization profiles. This ticket defines the program goals, operational runbook, experiment matrix, rollout plan, and success metrics. It centralizes cross-functional work (runtime, infra, console, devexp) into a single operational roadmap to enable safe, measurable cost savings without degrading model quality or SLA targets.
goals: 1) Achieve ≥18% average unit-cost reduction on mid-tail workloads within 3 months of rollout. 2) Maintain p95 latency within 1.2x baseline and p50 within 1.05x. 3) Detect and prevent quality regressions (≤0.5% QA alert rate) via automated evals and rollback policies.
success_criteria: - Measured reduction in cost-per-1M-tokens on representative workload cohort (dashboard metric) >=18% post-rollout. - No increase in customer-facing error rate above 0.2%. - Eval suite quality delta per-model <= 1.0% (primary metric) and auto-rollback triggers validated.
milestones: M1: Experiment matrix finalization & infra readiness (by 2025-02-28)
M2: Canary rollout of dynamic batching + KV cache to 5% traffic on dedicated clusters (by 2025-03-31)
M3: Quantization pilot (4-bit/8-bit profiles) on op-sensitive models with eval suites (by 2025-04-30)
M4: Console controls and per-route cost toggle GA (by 2025-05-15)
M5: Full rollout and post-rollout measurement window complete (by 2025-05-30)

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Aggressive batching increases p95 latency and harms interactive flows. Mitigation: implement latency-aware dynamic batching; set strict p95 guardrails and progressive ramping.
Risk: Quantization introduces quality regressions for instruction-heavy prompts. Mitigation: model-family specific evals, dual inference path fallback to fp16 if quality drop >1.5% on eval set.
Risk: Cache consistency and cold-start semantics cause customer confusion. Mitigation: document expected cache TTL behavior, expose cache hit-rate telemetry per route, provide opt-out.
Risk: Dedicated/private customers require explicit approval. Mitigation: choreograph dedicated release with Solutions Eng and provide a per-tenant enable flag and support playbook.
operational_runbook_snippets: Canary strategy: start at 5% traffic with 24h hold for baseline metrics; expand to 25% if no regression; full roll at 72h after stable metrics.
Rollback triggers: p95 latency >1.5x baseline for 30m OR quality delta >1.0% on eval signals OR error rate increase >0.2%.
On-call steps: 1) pause experiment via control plane toggle, 2) revert to previous model/quant profile, 3) open incident with tags savings-bridge and impact, 4) notify customers in impacted cohort.
